Quick read on the snapshot and infra metrics — preliminary notes:
- We see a burst of long-context requests (sequence lengths spiked 3x) from two FinFolio routes at 06:28–06:35; those requests triggered slower attention kernels and increased KV cache churn.
- Dedicated GPU pool for their reservation is at 98% utilization for sustained windows; autoscaling didn't add capacity due to quota ceiling on the reserved pool.
- Error wave (503) corresponds to queue saturation and preemption of lower-priority batches.

Immediate mitigations I can push now (low-risk to prod):
1) Route 20% of FinFolio traffic to a compatible quantized model variant (latency lower for short responses) — will reduce pressure by ~18–25%. Patch attached (proposed_fallback_route.patch).
2) Enable temporary reserved burst override for 4 hours (we need Jonas/exec approval to exceed reserved cap for a customer override).
3) Apply short-term request-size throttle for requests >8k tokens with a soft 429 with guidance to retry smaller chunks.

I'll kick off the fallback route and throttle immediately if I get a go-ahead. Full RCA will follow.

— David
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime

Date: 2025-10-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Post-mitigation summary and exec request — FinFolio outage window 06:30 PT (10/15)

Team — final update after monitoring and short remediation:
- Mitigations applied: fallback routing 20% (10/15 09:25 PT), short-request-size throttle (09:30 PT). Both reduced queueing pressure; p99 dropped from ~4.9s to 1.1s and 5xx rate fell to ~0.8%.
- Remaining risk: the root cause is a workload pattern (sudden long-context burst) that will reoccur under similar user behavior. The dedicated pool reached soft capacity and cannot autoscale higher for reserved seats without an override.

Requested approvals:
1) Approve a 48-hour burst capacity override for FinFolio (estimated $1.8k incremental) to fully absorb potential rebound while we deploy a hardened fallback policy and KV-cache prewarming.
2) Approve a 1-week follow-up technical review and a scheduled implementation of an adaptive throttling policy for >6k token requests.

Jonas — can you sign off on the temporary burst? I will prepare the DocuSign if we have buy-in from Finance. Sasha, Marissa and I will coordinate a customer-facing post-mortem and proposed SLA guardrails.

Thanks everyone — will keep the loop updated.

Sofia Ivanova
